ne36:1.2: pubbā koci na paññāyati avijjāya ca bhavataṇhāya ca. tattha avijjā nīvaraṇaṃ, taṇhāsaṃyojanaṃ.
ne36:1.3: avijjānīvaraṇā sattā avijjāsaṃyuttā avijjāpakkhena vicaranti. te vuccanti “diṭṭhicaritā”ti,
ne36:1.4: taṇhāsaṃyojanā sattā taṇhāsaṃyuttā taṇhāpakkhena vicaranti, te vuccanti “taṇhācaritā”ti.
ne36:1.5: diṭṭhicaritā ito bahiddhā pabbajitā attakilamathānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti
ne36:1.6: taṇhācaritā ito bahiddhā pabbajitā kāmesu kāmasukhallikānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti.
ne36:2.1: tattha kiṃ kāraṇaṃ yaṃ diṭṭhicaritā ito bahiddhā pabbajitā attakilamathānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti, taṇhācaritā ito bahiddhā pabbajitā kāmesu kāmasukhallikānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti:
ne36:2.2: ito bahiddhā natthi saccavacatthānaṃ, kuto catusaccappakāsanā samathavipassanākosallaṃ vā upasamasukhappatti vā.
ne36:2.3: upasamasukhassa anabhiññā viparītacetā evamāhaṃsu: natthi sukhena sukhaṃ, dukkhena nāma sukhamadhigantabbaṃ,
ne36:2.4: yo kāme paṭisevati so lokaṃ vaḍḍhayati, yo lokaṃ vaḍḍhayati so bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavatī”ti. te evaṃsaññī evaṃdiṭṭhi dukkhena sukhaṃ patthayamānā kāmesu puññasaññi attakilamathānuyogamanuyuttā ca viharanti kāmasukhallikānuyogamanuyuttā ca. te tadabhiññā santā rogameva vaḍḍhayanti gaṇḍameva vaḍḍhayanti sallameva vaḍḍhayanti. te rogābhitunnā gaṇḍapaṭipīḷitā sallānuviddhā nirayatiracchānayonipetāsuresu ummujjanimmujjāni karontā ugghātanigghātaṃ paccanubhontā rogagaṇḍasallabhesajjaṃ na vindanti.
ne36:2.5: tattha attakilamathānuyogo kāmasukhallikānuyogo ca saṃkileso, samathavipassanā vodānaṃ,
ne36:2.6: attakilamathānuyogo kāmasukhallikānuyogo ca rogo; samathavipassanā roganigghātakabhesajjaṃ
ne36:2.7: attakilamathānuyogo kāmasukhallikānuyogo ca gaṇḍo, samathavipassanā gaṇḍanigghātakabhesajjaṃ.
ne36:2.8: attakilamathānuyogo kāmasukhallikānuyogo ca sallo, samathavipassanā salluddharaṇabhesajjaṃ.
ne36:3.1: tattha saṃkileso dukkhaṃ, tadabhisaṅgo taṇhā samudayo, taṇhānirodho dukkhanirodho, samathavipassanā dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā. imāni cattāri saccāni:
ne36:3.2: dukkhaṃ pariññeyyaṃ samudayo pahātabbo maggo bhāvetabbo nirodho sacchikātabbo.
ne36:4.7: attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ,
ne36:4.11: viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ upagacchanti, attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati vīsativatthukā sakkāyadiṭṭhi.
ne36:5.1: tassā paṭipakkho lokuttarā sammādiṭṭhi, anvāyikā sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi, ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo.
ne36:5.2: te tayo khandhā: sīlakkhandho samādhikkhandho paññākkhandho.
ne36:5.3: sīlakkhandho samādhikkhandho ca samatho, paññākkhandho vipassanā.
ne36:5.4: tattha sakkāyo dukkhaṃ, sakkāyasamudayo dukkhasamudayo, sakkāyanirodho dukkha nirodho, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā. imāni cattāri saccāni,
ne36:5.5: dukkhaṃ pariññeyyaṃ samudayo pahātabbo maggo bhāvetabbo nirodho sacchikātabbo.
ne36:6.8: attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ,
ne36:6.12: ye viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ upagacchanti, attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ,
ne36:6.13: ime vuccanti ‘sassatavādino’ti. tattha ucchedasassatavādā ubho antā, ayaṃ saṃsārappavatti.
ne36:6.14: tassa paṭipakkho majjhimā paṭipadā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, ayaṃ saṃsāranivatti.
ne36:6.15: tattha pavatti dukkhaṃ, tadabhisaṅgo taṇhā samudayo, taṇhānirodho dukkhanirodho, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo dukkha nirodhagāminī paṭipadā, imāni cattāri saccāni.
ne36:6.16: dukkhaṃ pariññeyyaṃ samudayo pahātabbo maggo bhāvetabbo nirodho sacchikātabbo.
ne36:7.1: tattha ucchedasassataṃ samāsato vīsativatthukā sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vitthārato dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni, tesaṃ paṭipakkho tecattālīsaṃ bodhipakkhiyā dhammā, aṭṭha vimokkhā, dasa kasiṇāyatanāni.
ne36:7.3: tetālīsaṃ bodhi pakkhiyā dhammā ñāṇavajiraṃ mohajālappadāḷanaṃ.
ne36:7.4: tattha moho avijjā, jālaṃ bhavataṇhā. tena vuccati: “pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjāya ca bhavataṇhāya cā”ti.
ne36:8.1: tattha diṭṭhicarito asmiṃ sāsane pabbajito sallekhānusantata vutti bhavati sallekhe tibbagāravo,
ne36:8.2: taṇhācarito asmiṃ sāsane pabbajito sikkhānusantatavutti bhavati sikkhāya tibbagāravo,
ne36:8.4: taṇhācarito sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamanto saddhānusārī bhavati, diṭṭhicarito sukhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya khippābhiññāya ca niyyāti,
ne36:8.5: taṇhācarito dukkhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya khippābhiññāya ca niyyāti,
ne36:9.1: tattha kiṃ kāraṇaṃ: yaṃ taṇhācarito dukkhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya khippābhiññāya ca niyyāti, tassa hi kāmā apariccattā bhavanti. so kāmehi viveciyamāno dukkhena paṭinissarati dandhaṃ ca dhammaṃ ājānāti.
ne36:9.2: yo panā’yaṃ diṭṭhicarito, ayaṃ ādito yeva kāmehi anatthiko bhavati.
ne36:9.3: so tato viveciyamāno khippañca paṭinissarati khippañca dhammaṃ ājānāti.
ne36:9.4: dukkhāpi paṭipadā duvidhā: dandhābhiññā ca khippābhiññā ca.
ne36:9.5: sukhāpi paṭipadā duvidhā: dandhābhiññā ca: khippābhiññā ca.
ne36:9.7: ye mudindriyā te dandhaṃ ca paṭinissaranti, dandhañca dhammaṃ ājānanti,
ne36:9.8: ye tikkhindriyā te khippañca paṭinissaranti, khippañca dhammaṃ ājānanti. imā catasso paṭipadā,
ne36:9.9: ye hi keci nīyiṃsu vā niyyanti vā nīyissanti vā, te imāhi eva catuhi paṭipadāhi.
ne36:9.10: evaṃ ariyā catukkamaggaṃ paññāpenti abudhajanasevitāya bālakantāya rattavāsiniyā nandiyā bhavataṇhāya āvaṭṭanatthaṃ.
ne36:9.11: ayaṃ vuccati nandiyāvaṭṭassa nayassa bhūmīti. tenāha: “taṇhañca avijjampi ca samathenā”ti.
ne36:10.1: “veyyākaraṇesu hi ye kusalā’kusalā”ti te duvidhena upaparikkhitabbā:
ne36:10.8: upacayena sabbepi kilesā catuhi vipallāsehi niddisitabbā.
ne36:10.12: cattāro āhārā cattāro vipallāsā cattāri upādānāni cattāro yogā cattāro ganthā cattāro āsavā cattāro oghā cattāro sallā catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo cattāri agatigamanāni.
ne36:10.13: paṭhame āhāre paṭhamo vipallāso, dutiye āhāre dutiye vipallāso, tatiye āhāre tatiyo vipallāso, catutthe āhāre catuttho vipallāso.
ne36:10.15: dutiye vipallāse dutiyaṃ upādānaṃ, tatiye vipallāse tatiyaṃ upādānaṃ. catutthe vipallāse catutthaṃ upādānaṃ.
ne36:10.16: paṭhame upādāne paṭhamo yogo, dutiye upādāne dutiyo yogo, tatiye upādāne tatiyo yogo, catutthe upādāne catuttho yogo.
ne36:10.17: paṭhame yoge paṭhamo gantho, dutiye yoge dutiyo gantho, tatiye yoge tatiyo gantho, catutthe yoge catuttho gantho.
ne36:10.18: paṭhame ganthe paṭhamo āsavo, dutiye ganthe dutiyo āsavā, tatiye ganthe tatiyo āsavo, catutthe ganthe catuttho āsavo.
ne36:10.19: paṭhame āsave paṭhamo ogho, dutiye āsave dutiyo ogho, tatiye āsave tatiye ogho, catutthe āsave catuttho ogho.
ne36:10.20: paṭhame oghe paṭhamo sallo, dutiye oghe dutiye sallo. tatiye oghe tatiyo sallo, catutthe oghe catuttho sallo,
ne36:10.21: paṭhame salle paṭhamā viññāṇaṭṭhiti, dutiye salle dutiyā viññāṇaṭṭhiti, tatiye salle tatiyā viññāṇaṭṭhiti, catutthe salle catuttho viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
ne36:10.22: paṭhamāyaṃ viññāṇaṭṭhitiyaṃ paṭhamaṃ agatigamanaṃ, dutiyāyaṃ viññāṇaṭṭhitiyaṃ dutiyaṃ agatigamanaṃ, tatiyāyaṃ viññāṇaṭṭhitiyaṃ tatiyaṃ agatigamanaṃ, catutthiyaṃ viññāṇaṭṭhitiyaṃ catutthaṃ agatigamanaṃ.
ne36:11.1: tattha yo ca kabaḷiṃkāro, āhāro yo ca phasso āhāro, ime taṇhācaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā,
ne36:11.2: yo ca manosañcetanāhāro yo ca viññāṇāhāro, ime diṭṭhicaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā,
ne36:11.3: tattha yo ca ‘asubhe subha’nti vipallāso, yo ca ‘dukkhe sukha’nti vipallāso. ime taṇhācaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.4: yo ca ‘anicce nicca’nti vipallāso yo ca ‘anattani attā’ti vipallāso ime diṭṭhicaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.5: tattha yañca kāmupādānaṃ yañca bhavūpādānaṃ, ime taṇhācaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.6: yañca diṭṭhūpādānaṃ yañca attavādūpādānaṃ, ime diṭṭhicaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.7: tattha yo ca kāmayogo yo ca bhavayogo, ime taṇhācaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.8: yo ca diṭṭhiyogo yo ca avijjāyogo, ime diṭṭhicaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.9: tattha yo ca abhijjhā kāyagantho yo ca byāpādo kāyagantho, ime taṇhācaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.10: yo ca parāmāsakāyagantho yo ca idaṃ saccābhinivesakāyagantho, ime diṭṭhicaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā
ne36:11.11: tattha yo ca kāmāsavo yo ca bhavāsavo, ime taṇhācaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.12: yo ca diṭṭhāsavo yo ca avijjāsavo, ime diṭṭhicaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.13: tattha yo ca kāmogho yo ca bhavogho, ime taṇhācaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.14: yo ca diṭṭhogho yo ca avijjogho, ime diṭṭhicaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.15: tattha yo ca rāgasallo yo ca dosasallo, ime taṇhācaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.16: yo ca mānasallo yo ca mohasallo ime diṭṭhicaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.17: tattha yā ca rūpūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti yā ca vedanūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti, ime taṇhācaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.18: yā ca saññūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti yā ca saṅkhārūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti, ime diṭṭhicaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.19: tattha yañca chandā agatigamanaṃ yañca dosā agatigamanaṃ, ime taṇhācaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:11.20: yañca bhayā agatigamanaṃ yañca mohā agatigamanaṃ, ime diṭṭhicaritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:12.1: tattha kabaḷiṅkāre āhāre asubhe subhanti vipallāso, phasse āhāre dukkhe sukhanti vipallāso. viññāṇe āhāre anicce niccanti vipallāso manosañcetanāya āhāre anattani attāti vipallāso.
ne36:12.2: paṭhame vipallāse ṭhito kāme upādiyati, idaṃ vuccati kāmūpādānaṃ.
ne36:12.3: dutiye vipallāse ṭhito anāgataṃ bhavaṃ upādiyati, idaṃ vuccati bhavūpādānaṃ.
ne36:12.4: tatiye vipallāse ṭhito saṃsārābhinandiniṃ diṭṭhiṃ upādiyati, idaṃ vuccati diṭṭhūpādānaṃ.
ne36:13.1: kāmūpādānena kāmehi saṃyujjati, ayaṃ vuccati kāmayogo.
ne36:13.2: bhavupādānena bhavehi saṃyujjati, ayaṃ vuccati bhavayogo.
ne36:13.3: diṭṭhūpādānena pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā saṃyujjati, ayaṃvuccati diṭṭhiyogo.
ne36:13.4: attavādūpādānena avijjāya saṃyujjati, ayaṃ vuccati avijjāyogo.
ne36:14.1: paṭhame yoge ṭhito abhijjhāya kāyaṃ ganthati, ayaṃ vuccati abhijjhākāyagantho.
ne36:14.2: dutiye yoge ṭhito byāpādena kāyaṃ ganthati, ayaṃ vuccati pyāpādakāyagantho.
ne36:14.3: tatiye yoge ṭhito parāmāsena kāyaṃ ganthati, ayaṃ vuccati parāmāsakāyagantho.
ne36:14.4: catutthe yoge ṭhito idaṃ saccābhinivesena kāyaṃ ganthati, ayaṃ vuccati idaṃsaccābhinivesakāyagantho.
ne36:15.4: tattha abhijjhākāyaganthena kāmāsavo, byāpādakāyaganthena bhavāsavo, parāmāsakāyaganthena diṭṭhāsavo, idaṃ saccābhinivesakāyaganthena avijjāsavo.
ne36:16.1: tassa ime cattāro āsavā vepullaṃ gatā oghā bhavanti,
ne36:16.3: tattha kāmāsavena kāmogho, bhavāsavena bhavogho, diṭṭhāsavena diṭṭhogho, avijjāsavena avijjogho.
ne36:17.1: tassa ime cattāro oghā anusayasahagatā ajjhāsayamanupaviṭṭhā. hadayaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhanti, tena vuccanti “sallā”iti.
ne36:17.2: tattha kāmo ghena rāgasallo, bhavoghena dosasallo, diṭṭhoghena mānasallo, avijjoghena mohasallo.
ne36:18.1: tassa imehi catuhi sallehi pariyādinnaṃ viññāṇaṃ catusu dhammesu saṇṭhahati. rūpe vedanāya saññāya saṅkhāresu.
ne36:18.2: tattha rāgasallena nandūpasecanena viññāṇena rūpūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti, dosasallena nandūpasecanena viññāṇena vedanūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti, mānasallena nandūpasecanena viññāṇena saññūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti, mohasallena nandūpasecanena viññāṇena saṅkhārūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
ne36:19.1: tassa imāhi catūhi viññāṇaṭṭhiti upatthaddhaṃ viññāṇaṃ catuhi dhammehi agatiṃ gacchati chandā dosā bhayā mohā.
ne36:19.2: tattha rāgena chandāgatiṃ gacchati, dosena dosāgatiṃ gacchati, bhayena bhayāgatiṃ gacchati, mohena mohāgatiṃ gacchati.
ne36:19.3: iti kho tañca kammaṃ ime ca kilesā. esa hetu saṃsārassa. evaṃ sabbe kilesā catuhi vipallāsehi niddisitabbā.
ne36:20.1: tattha imā catasso disā: kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro asubhe subhanti vipallāso kāmūpādānaṃ kāmayogo abhijjhākāyagantho kāmāsavo kāmogho rāgasallo rūpūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti chandā agatigamananti paṭhamā disā.
ne36:21.1: phasso āhāro dukkhe sukhanti vipallāso bhavūpādānaṃ bhavayogo byāpādakāyagantho bhavāsavo bhavogho dosasallo vedanūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti dosā agatigamananti dutiyā disā.
ne36:22.1: viññāṇāhāro anicce niccanti vipallāso diṭṭhūpādānaṃ diṭṭhiyogo parāmāsakāya gantho diṭṭhāsavo diṭṭhogho mānasallo saññūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti bhayā agatigamananti tatiyā disā.
ne36:23.1: manosañcetanāhāro anattani attāti vipallāso attavādūpādānaṃ avijjāyogo idaṃsaccābhinivesakāyagantho avijjāsavo avijjogho mohasallo saṅkhārūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti mohā agatigamananti catutthi disā.
ne36:24.1: tattha yo ca kabaḷiṅkāro āhāro yo ca asubhe subhanti vipallāso kāmūpādānaṃ kāmayogo abhijjhākāyagantho kāmāsavo kāmogho rāgasallo rūpūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti chandā agatigamananti imesaṃ dasannaṃ suttānaṃ eko attho byañjanameva nānaṃ,
ne36:25.1: tattha yo ca phasso āhāro yo ca dukkhe sukhanti vipallāso bhavūpādānaṃ bhavayogo byāpādakāyagantho bhavāsavo bhavogho dosasallo vedanūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti dosā agatigamananti imesaṃ dasannaṃ suttānaṃ eko attho byañjanameva nānaṃ, ime dosa caritassa puggalassa upakkilesā.
ne36:26.1: tattha yo ca viññāṇāhāro yo ca anicce niccanti vipallāso diṭṭhūpādānaṃ diṭṭhiyogo parāmāsakāyagantho diṭṭhāsavo diṭṭhogho mānasallo saññūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti bhayā agatigamananti imesaṃ dasannaṃ suttānaṃ eko attho byañjanameva nānaṃ,
ne36:27.1: tattha yo ca manosañcetanāhāro ye ca anattani attāti vipallāse attavādūpādānaṃ avijjāyogo idaṃsaccābhinivesakāya gantho avijjāsavo avijjogho mohasallo saṅkhārūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti mohā agatigamananti imesaṃ dasannaṃ suttānaṃ eko attho byañjanameva nānaṃ,
ne36:28.1: tattha yo ca kabaḷiṃkārāhāro yo ca phasso āhāro, ime appaṇihitena vimokkhamukhena pariññaṃ gacchanti, viññāṇāhāro suññatāya, manosañcetanāhāro animittena. tattha yo ca asubhe subhanti vipallāso yo ca dukkhe sukhanti vipallāso, ime appaṇihitena vimokkhamukhena pahānaṃ abbhatthaṃ gacchanti,
ne36:28.2: anicce niccanti vipallāso suññatāya, anattani attāti vipallāso animittena.
ne36:28.3: tattha kāmūpādānaṃ ca bhavūpādānaṃ ca appaṇihitena vimokkhamukhena pahānaṃ gacchanti,
ne36:28.5: tattha kāmayogo ca bhavayogo ca appaṇihitena vimokkhamukhena pahānaṃ gacchanti, diṭṭhiyogo suññatāya, avijjāyogo animittena.
ne36:28.6: tattha abhijjhākāyagantho ca byāpādakāyagantho ca appaṇihitena vimokkhamukhena pahānaṃ gacchanti, parāmāsakāyagantho suññatāya, idaṃsaccābhinivesakāyagantho animittena.
ne36:29.1: tattha kāmāsavo ca bhavāsavo ca appaṇihitena vimokkhamukhena pahānaṃ gacchanti, diṭṭhāsavo suññatāya, avijjāsavo animittena.
ne36:29.2: tattha kāmogho ca bhavogho ca appaṇihitena vimokkhamukhena pahānaṃ gacchanti, diṭṭhogho suññatāya, avijjogho animittena.
ne36:29.3: tattha rāgasallo ca dosasallo ca appaṇihitena vimokkhamukhena pahānaṃ gacchanti, mānasallo suññatāya, mohasallo animittena.
ne36:29.4: tattha rūpūpagā ca viññāṇaṭṭhiti vedanūpagā ca viññāṇaṭṭhiti appaṇihitena vimokkhamukhena pariññaṃ gacchanti, saññūpagā suññatāya, saṅkhārūpagā animittena.
ne36:30.1: tattha chandā ca agatigamanaṃ dosā ca agatigamanaṃ appaṇihitena vimokkhamukhena pahānaṃ gacchanti, bhayā agatigamanaṃ suññatāya, mohā agatigamanaṃ animittena vimokkhamukhena pahānaṃ gacchanti.
ne36:32.1: catasso paṭipadā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāri jhānāni cattāro vihārā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā cattāri adhiṭṭhānāni catasso samādhibhāvanā cattāro sukhabhāgiyā dhammā catasso appamāṇā.
ne36:33.1: paṭhamā paṭipadā paṭhamaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ, dutiyā paṭipadā dutiyaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ, tatiyā paṭipadā tatiyaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ, catutthā paṭipadā catutthaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne36:33.2: paṭhamaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ, dutiyaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ, tatiyaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ, catutthaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ.
ne36:33.3: paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ paṭhamo vihāro, dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ dutiyo vihāro, tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ tatiyo vihāro, catutthaṃ jhānaṃ catuttho vihāro.
ne36:33.4: paṭhamo vihāro paṭhamaṃ sammappadhānaṃ, dutiyo dutiyaṃ, tatiyo tatiyaṃ, catuttho vihāro catutthaṃ sammappadhānaṃ
ne36:33.5: paṭhamaṃ sammappadhānaṃ paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, dutiyaṃ dutiyo, tatiyaṃ tatiyo, catutthaṃ sammappadhānaṃ catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo.
ne36:33.6: paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo paṭhamaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ, dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo dutiyaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ, tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo tatiyaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ, catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo catutthaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ.
ne36:33.7: paṭhamaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ paṭhamā samādhibhāvanā, dutiyaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ dutiyā samādhibhāvanā, tatiyaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ tatiyā samādhibhāvanā, catutthaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ catutthā samādhibhāvanā.
ne36:33.8: paṭhamā samādhibhāvanā paṭhamo sukhabhāgiyo dhammo, dutiyā samādhibhāvanā dutiyo sukhabhāgiyo dhammo, tatiyā samādhibhāvanā tatiyo sukhabhāgiyo dhammo, catutthā samādhibhāvanā catuttho sukhabhāgiyo dhammo.
ne36:33.9: paṭhamo sukhabhāgiyo dhammo paṭhamaṃ appamāṇaṃ, dutiyo sukhabhāgiyo dhammo dutiyaṃ appamāṇaṃ, tatiyo sukhabhāgiyo dhammo tatiyaṃ appamāṇaṃ, catuttho sukhabhāgiyo dhammo catutthaṃ appamāṇaṃ.
ne36:33.10: paṭhamā paṭipadā bhāvitā bahulīkatā paṭhamaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ paripūreti, dutiyā paṭipadā bhāvitā bahulīkatā dutiyaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ paripūreti. tatiyā paṭipadā bhāvitā bahulīkatā tatiyaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ paripūreti. catutthā paṭipadā bhāvitā bahulīkatā catutthaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ paripūreti.
ne36:33.11: paṭhamo satipaṭṭhāno bhāvito bahulīkato paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ paripūreti, dutiyo satipaṭṭhāno bhāvito bahulīkato dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ paripūreti, tatiyo satipaṭṭhāno bhāvito bahulīkato tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ paripūreti, catuttho satipaṭṭhāno bhāvito bahulīkato catutthaṃ jhānaṃ paripūreti,
ne36:34.1: paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ paṭhamaṃ vihāraṃ paripūreti, dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ dutiyaṃ vihāraṃ paripūreti, tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ tatiyaṃ vihāraṃ paripūreti, catutthaṃ jhānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ catutthaṃ vihāraṃ paripūreti,
ne36:34.2: paṭhamo vihāro bhāvito bahulīkato anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādaṃ paripūreti, dutiyo vihāro bhāvito bahulīkato uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ paripūreti, tatiyo vihāro bhāvito bahulīkato anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādaṃ paripūreti, catutthe vihāro bhāvito bahulīkato uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiṃ asammosaṃ bhiyyobhāvaṃ paripūreti,
ne36:34.3: paṭhamaṃ sammappadhānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ mānappahānaṃ paripūreti, dutiyaṃ sammappadhānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ ālayasamugghātaṃ paripūreti, tatiyaṃ sammappadhānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ avijjāpahānaṃ paripūreti, catutthaṃ sammappadhānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ bhavūpasamaṃ paripūreti,
ne36:34.4: mānapahānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ saccādhiṭṭhānaṃ paripūreti, ālayasamugghāto bhāvito bahulīkato cāgādhiṭṭhānaṃ paripūreti, avijjāpahānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ paññādhiṭṭhānaṃ paripūreti, bhavūpasamo bhāvito bahulīkato upasamādhiṭṭhānaṃ paripūreti,
ne36:34.5: saccādhiṭṭhānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ chanda samādhiṃ paripūreti, cāgādhiṭṭhānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ viriyasamādhiṃ paripūreti, paññādhiṭṭhānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ cittasamādhiṃ paripūreti, upasamādhiṭṭhānaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ vīmaṃsāsamādhiṃ paripūreti,
ne36:34.6: chandasamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato indriyasaṃvaraṃ paripūreti, viriyasamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato tapaṃ paripūreti, cittasamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato buddhi paripūreti, vīmaṃsāsamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato sabbūpadhīpaṭinissaggaṃ paripūreti.
ne36:34.7: indriyasaṃvaro bhāvito bahulīkato mettaṃ paripūreti, tapo bhāvito bahulīkato karuṇaṃ paripūreti, buddhi bhāvitā bahulīkatā muditaṃ paripūreti, sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo bhāvito bahulīkato upekkhaṃ paripūreti.
ne36:35.1: tattha imā catasso disā; paṭhamā paṭipadā paṭhamo satipaṭṭhāno paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ paṭhamo vihāro paṭhamo sammappadhāno paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saccādhiṭṭhānaṃ chandasamādhi indriyasaṃvaro mettā iti paṭhamā disā.
ne36:36.1: dutiyā paṭipadā dutiyo satipaṭṭhāno dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ dutiyo vihāro dutiyo sammappadhāno dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo cāgādhiṭṭhānaṃ viriyasamādhi tapo karuṇā iti dutiyā disā,
ne36:37.1: tatiyā paṭipadā tatiyo satipaṭṭhāno tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ tatiyo vihāro tatiyo sammappadhāno tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo paññādhiṭṭhānaṃ cittasamādhi buddhi muditā iti tatiyā disā.
ne36:38.1: catutthā paṭipadā catuttho satipaṭṭhāno catutthaṃ jhānaṃ catuttho vihāro catuttho sammappadhāno catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo upasamādhiṭṭhānaṃ vīmaṃsāsamādhi sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo upekkhā iti catutthā disā.
ne36:39.1: tattha paṭhamā paṭipadā paṭhamo satipaṭṭhāno paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ paṭhamo vihāro paṭhamo sammappadhāno paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saccādhiṭṭhānaṃ chandasamādhi indriyasaṃvaro mettā iti imesaṃ dasannaṃ suttānaṃ eko attho byañjanameva nānaṃ.
ne36:40.1: dutiyā paṭipadā dutiyo satipaṭṭhāno dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ dutiyo vihāro dutiyo sammappadhāno dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo cāgādhiṭṭhānaṃ viriyasamādhi tapo karuṇā iti imesaṃ dasannaṃ suttānaṃ eko attho byañjanameva nānaṃ.
ne36:41.1: tatiyā paṭipadā tatiyo satipaṭṭhāno tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ tatiyo vihāro tatiyo sammappadhāno tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo paññādhiṭṭhānaṃ cittasamādhi buddhi muditā iti imesaṃ dasannaṃ suttānaṃ eko attho byañjanameva nānaṃ.
ne36:42.1: catutthā paṭipadā catuttho satipaṭṭhāno catutthaṃ jhānaṃ catuttho vihāro catuttho. sammappadhāno catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo upasamādhiṭṭhānaṃ vīmaṃsāsamādhi sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo upekkho iti imesaṃ dasannaṃ suttānaṃ eko attho byañjanameva nānaṃ.
ne36:43.1: tattha dukkhā ca paṭipadā dandhābhiññā dukkhā ca paṭipadā khippā bhiññā appaṇihitaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ, sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā suññatavimokkhamukhaṃ, sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā animitta vimokkhamukhaṃ.
ne36:44.1: tattha kāye kāyānupassitā satipaṭṭhānaṃ ca vedanāsu vedanānupassitā satipaṭṭhānaṃ ca appaṇihitaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ, citte cittānupassitā suññatā vimokkhamukhaṃ,
ne36:45.1: tattha paṭhamañca jhānaṃ dutiyaṃ ca jhānaṃ appaṇihitaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ suññātā, catutthaṃ jhānaṃ animittaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ.
ne36:46.1: tattha paṭhamo ca vihāro dutiyo ca vihāro appaṇihitaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ, tatiyo vihāro suññatā, catuttho vihāro animittaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ.
ne36:47.1: tattha paṭhamaṃ ca sammappadhānaṃ dutiyaṃ ca sammappadhānaṃ appaṇihitaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ, tatiyaṃ sammappadhānaṃ suññatā, catutthaṃ sammappadhānaṃ animittaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ.
ne36:48.1: tattha mānapahānaṃ ca ālayasamugghāto ca appaṇihitaṃ vimekkhamukhaṃ avijjāpahānaṃ suññatā, bhavūpasamo animittaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ.
ne36:49.1: tattha saccādhiṭṭhānaṃ ca cāgādhiṭṭhānaṃ ca appaṇihitaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ, paññādhiṭṭhānaṃ suññatā, upasamādhiṭṭhānaṃ animittaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ.
ne36:50.1: tattha chandasamādhi viriyasamādhi ca appaṇihitaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ, citta samādhi suññatā, vīmaṃsāsamādhi animittaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ.
ne36:51.1: tattha indriyasaṃvaro ca tapo ca appaṇihitaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ, buddhi suññatā sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo animittaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ.
ne36:52.1: tattha mettā ca karuṇā ca appaṇihitaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ, muditā suññatā, upekkhā animittaṃ vimokkhamukhaṃ.
ne36:53.2: cattāro āhārā, tesaṃ paṭipakkho catasso paṭipadā
ne36:53.3: cattāro vipallāsā, tesaṃ paṭipakkho cattāro satipaṭṭhānā
ne36:53.4: cattāri upādānāni, tesaṃ paṭipakkho cattāri jhānāni.
ne36:53.5: cattāro yogā, tesaṃ paṭipakkho cattāro vihārā,
ne36:53.6: cattāro ganthā, tesaṃ paṭipakkho cattāro sammappadhānaṃ
ne36:53.7: cattāro āsavā tesaṃ paṭipakkho cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā
ne36:53.9: cattāro sallā, tesaṃ paṭipakkho catasso samādhibhāvanā
ne36:53.10: catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo, tesaṃ paṭipakkho cattāro sukhabhāgiyā dhammā.
ne36:53.11: cattāri agatigamanāni, tesaṃ paṭipakkho catasso appamāṇā.
ne36:54.1: sīhā: buddhā paccekabuddhā sāvakā ca hatarāgadosamohā; tesaṃ vikkīḷitaṃ bhāvanā sacchikiriyā byantīkiriyā ca,
ne36:54.2: vikkīḷitaṃ indriyādhiṭṭhā naṃ, vikkīḷitaṃ vipariyāsānadhiṭṭhānaṃ ca
ne36:54.4: ayaṃ vuccati sīhavikkīḷitassa ca nayassa disālocanassa ca nayassa bhūmīti.
ne36:55.1: tattha ye dukkhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya khippābhiññāya ca nīyanti ime dve puggalā.
ne36:55.2: ye sukhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya khippābhiññāya ca nīyanti ime dve puggalā.
ne36:55.3: tesaṃ catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ ayaṃ saṃkileso: cattāro āhārā cattāro vipallāsā cattāri upādānāni cattāro yogā cattāro ganthā cattāro āsavā cattāro oghā cattāro sallā catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo cattāri agatigamanānīti.
ne36:55.4: tesaṃ catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ idaṃ vodānaṃ: catasso paṭipadā cattāro vihārā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā cattāri adhiṭṭhānāni catasso samādhibhāvanā cattāro sukhabhāgiyā dhammā catasso appamāṇā iti.
ne36:56.1: tattha ye dukkhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya khippābhiññāya ca nīyanti ime dve puggalā
ne36:56.2: ye sukhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya khippābhiññāya ca nīyanti ime dve puggalā.
ne36:56.3: tattha yo sukhāya paṭipadāya khippābhiññāya ca nīyāti ayaṃ ugghaṭitaññū,
ne36:56.5: yo dukkhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya nīyāti ayaṃ neyyo.
ne36:57.1: tattha bhagavā ugghaṭitaññussa puggalassa samathaṃ upadisati, neyyassa vipassanaṃ, samathavipassanaṃ vipañcitaññussa.
ne36:57.2: tattha bhagavā ugghaṭitaññussa puggalassa mudukaṃ dhammadesanaṃ upadisati; tikkhaṃ neyyassa, mudutikkhaṃ vipañcitaññussa puggalassa. tattha bhagavā ugghaṭitaññussa puggalassa saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desayati, saṃkhittavitthārena vipañcitaññussa, vitthārena neyyassa.
ne36:57.3: tattha bhagavā ugghaṭitaññussa puggalassa nissaraṇaṃ upadisati, vipañcitaññussa ādīnavaṃ ca nissaraṇaṃ ca upadisati, neyyassa assādañca ādīnavaṃ ca nissaraṇaṃ ca upadisati.
ne36:57.4: tattha bhagavā ugghaṭitaññussa adhipaññāsikkhaṃ paññāpayati, adhicittaṃ vipañci taññussa, adhisīlaṃ neyyassa.
ne36:58.1: tattha ye dukkhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya khippābhiññāya ca nīyanti ime dve puggalā.
ne36:58.2: ye sukhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya khippābhiññāya ca nīyanti
ne36:58.4: iti kho cattāri hutvā tīṇi bhavanti. ugghaṭitaññū vipañcitaññū neyyoti.
ne36:59.1: tesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ ayaṃ saṃkileso: tīṇi akusalamūlāni: lobho akusalamūlaṃ doso akusalamūlaṃ moho akusalamūlaṃ, tīṇi duccaritāni:
ne36:59.10: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā,
ne36:59.20: akusalaṃ kāyakammaṃ akusalaṃ vacīkammaṃ akusalaṃ manokammaṃ,
ne36:59.25: alobho kusalamūlaṃ adoso kusalamūlaṃ amoho kusalamūlaṃ,
ne36:59.31: savitakko savicāro samādhi avitakko vicāramatto samādhi avitakko avicāro samādhi,
ne36:59.37: kusalaṃ kāyakammaṃ kusalaṃ vacīkammaṃ kusalaṃ manokammaṃ,
ne36:60.1: iti kho cattāri hutvā tīṇi bhavanti, tīṇi hutvā dve bhavanti: taṇhācarito ca diṭṭhicarito ca,
ne36:61.1: tesaṃ dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ ayaṃ saṃkileso: taṇhā ca avijjā ca ahirikañca anottappañca, asati ca asampajaññaṃ ca, ayonisomanasikāro ca kosajjañca dovacassañca ahaṅkāro ca mamaṃkāro ca assaddhā ca pamādo ca asaddhammasavaṇañca asaṃvaro ca abhijjhā ca vyāpādo ca nīvaraṇañca saṃyojanañca kodho ca upanāho ca makkho ca palāso ca issā ca maccherañca māyā ca sāṭheyyañca sassatadiṭṭhi ca ucchedadiṭṭhi cāti.
ne36:62.1: tesaṃ dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ idaṃ vodānaṃ: samatho ca vipassanā ca hiri ca ottappañca sati ca sampajaññañca yonisomanasikāro ca viriyārambho ca sovacassañca dhammeñāṇaṃ ca acacayeñāṇañca khayeñāṇañca anuppādeñāṇañca saddhā ca appamādo ca saddhamma savaṇañca saṃvaro ca anabhijjhā ca abyāpādo ca rāgavirāgā ca cetovimutti avijjāvirāgā ca paññāvimutti abhisamayo ca appicchatā ca santuṭṭhi ca akkodho ca anupanāho ca amakkho ca apalāso ca issāpahānañca macchariyapahānañca vijjā ca vimutti ca saṅkhatā rammaṇo ca vimokkho asaṅkhatārammaṇo ca vimokkho saupādisesā ca nibbānadhātu anupādisesā ca nibbānadhātūti.
ne36:63.1: ayaṃ vuccati tipukkhalassa ca nayassa aṃkusassa ca nayassa bhūmīti.
